messages:
sophie: FYI - spike in KMS decrypts from analytics-service after last night's roles/permissions refactor. Noticed via audit logs.
sam: details? which key and which principal?
jin: saw the same. Key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/analytics-key. Principal: analytics-service@infra-prod. Shouldn't have decrypt.
audit-bot: ALERT: 19 decrypts in 3min window by analytics-service@infra-prod (service account). Source IPs: 34.72.12.9, 34.72.12.10. Trace IDs attached.
olivia: marking P0. Can we immediately block decrypt for that SA? If yes do it and post commands.
sophie: Agreed. I'm applying a policy deny on the key to remove analytics-service decrypt. Patch below:
```
kubectl -n infra patch secret key-access --type=json -p='[{"op":"remove","path":"/bindings/analytics-service"}]'
```
sam: I don't think key access is stored in k8s secret; KMS IAM binding is GCP. Use gcloud:
```
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding analytics-key \
  --keyring=prod --location=global \
  --member=serviceAccount:analytics-service@infra-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```
dmitri: running the remove now (manual approval). I'll also add a deny policy as backup.
audit-bot: ACTION: removed binding for analytics-service@infra-prod at 2469123510 by dmitri.
jin: seeing decrypts drop to 0 after 2469123520, good.
olivia: next steps: 1) confirm no legitimate workflows rely on that SA decrypting key, 2) rotate key if the SA used it while permissions were open, 3) audit any exports of plaintext, 4) postmortem and CL rollback plan for the refactor.
sophie: step 1 - reach out to data-platform to confirm. jin can you own key rotation if needed?
jin: I can rotate. If we rotate we need to schedule ledgers backfill for any services using the key. I'll start an impact runbook.
sophie: creating follow-up incident ticket and tagging owners. Also log the exact CL that introduced the role change: git/changeset 8f4b3a (roles refactor). We'll revert or patch that CL in staging and add unit tests for KMS permissions mapping.
olivia: nice triage. Please add a short timeline and whether any customer data was exposed. For now treat as potential exposure until rotation completes. :warning:
sophie: will update ticket. Thanks everyone.
